lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a staggered grid posterior to the branchial slits, exhibiting a higher density towards the dorsal carinae.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal spot rows, creating a coordinate-like visual structure on the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges characterized by high-luminance upper boundaries and shadowed lower boundaries, running parallel from the post-cranial region toward the posterior of the visible torso.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density distribution of low-diameter white pixels located on the rostrum and head region, distinct from the larger lateral blobs; presence of multiple commensal organisms on the ventral surface.
